context: A boss reviews an intern report
purpose: Teach: 建材/渡米/前月/スペシャリスト/リコール/各所/積む/段ボール

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、建材市場、本気で、絶対、調査、絶対、進めてくれてるか、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — I need you to seriously commit to pushing forward the building materials market survey. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority without harshness. Lean in slightly on the request itself. Calm conviction that assumes competence and expects delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。教授の渡米、本気で、絶対、私も、絶対、随行、絶対、いただけることに、なりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm genuinely grateful that I'll be able to accompany the professor on the US research trip.
lines.style: Sincere and earnest. Slight formal register — respectful but not stiff. Genuine appreciation in the voice, not performed. A little breathless with actual gratitude.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 前月の研究進捗、本気で、絶対、まとめてくれ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need you to compile the research progress from last month. This is important.
lines.style: Clear, practical direction. No wasted words. Steady eye-contact level delivery. The tone of someone who knows Ren can do this and is simply stating the expectation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当該分野の、本気で、絶対、スペシャリスト、絶対、教授に、絶対、ご紹介、絶対、いただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm truly grateful that the professor introduced me to a specialist in this field.
lines.style: Warm gratitude underneath formal politeness. Soft opening, slight lift on the key phrase about the introduction. Recognition of the gift he's been given, voiced with quiet sincerity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 過去の論文、本気で、絶対、リコール、絶対、された事例、絶対、調べておけ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Look into past papers — specifically cases where research findings were recalled or disputed. I need you to know that history.
lines.style: Purposeful and slightly firmer than the previous requests. A subtle emphasis on the importance of this task. Still measured, but the weight is there.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。各所の研究機関、本気で、絶対、訪問、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm making progress on visiting research institutions across the field. Thank you for this opportunity.
lines.style: Composed, a little formal. Steady pacing. The gratitude is real but controlled — Ren showing respect through restraint rather than effusion. Professional yet warm beneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究データ、本気で、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、積むよう、絶対、整理しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure you organize and store the research data carefully. It needs to be handled with precision.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Emphasis on the care required — 'carefully' and 'precision' carry weight. The tone of someone who knows the difference between sloppy and thorough.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験器具、本気で、絶対、段ボール、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、梱包、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've carefully packed all the laboratory equipment in boxes. Everything is secure.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction in the completion. Factual, no flourish. A hint of relief — the task done right. Respectful closing note, as if signing off from the conversation.
